general.zh: 外链目标发现器：为某一域名查找真实、有效的可用外链目标地址，并做外链缺口分析。数据源仅用免费渠道（Tranco 排名、Bing 实时检索、手动核验种子库、本地已有外链导入），商业 DR/DA 一律标 unavailable，绝不估算。
general.en: Backlink Prospector finds real, valid backlink target addresses for a domain and computes the gap. Free-only data sources (Tranco rank, Bing live search, manually-verified seed library, local existing-backlink import). Commercial DR/DA are always marked unavailable, never estimated.

scoring.zh: 优先级 = 相关性(0–40) + 权威(0–30) + 可获取(0–30) = 0–100。权威层级 High=30 / Medium=20 / Low=10。无关键词时按类型基线给相关性。命中"write for us/contribute/guest/submit"等字样可获取分 +4。
scoring.en: Priority = Relevance(0–40) + Authority(0–30) + Obtainability(0–30) = 0–100. Authority tier High=30 / Medium=20 / Low=10. Without keywords, relevance uses a per-type baseline. URLs matching 'write for us/contribute/guest/submit' get +4 obtainability.

reciprocal.zh: 互链现已列为第 10 种独立类型 `reciprocal`（双向交换），与 directory（目录单向收录）明确区分：directory 是你被目录收录的单向链接；reciprocal 是你与对方互相挂链的双向关系。两者在缺口分析与外链池里分别统计。互链可获取性最高(29/30)、单条 SEO 价值最低，仅作「铺量兜底」、非主力权重来源。Google 把「以操纵 PageRank 为目的的互链」列为 link scheme，会降权甚至判违规——必须控比例（本系统默认告警阈值 30%）。实践：仅与有编辑标准的垂直站点/互补品牌互链，比例自然，不大规模互链。
reciprocal.en: Reciprocal linking is now a distinct 10th type `reciprocal` (mutual exchange), clearly separated from directory (one-way listing): directory = you are listed in a directory; reciprocal = you and the partner link to each other (two-way). They are tracked separately in gap analysis and the pool. Reciprocal has the highest obtainability (29/30) but the lowest per-link SEO value — a 'volume backstop', not a primary authority source. Google treats manipulative reciprocal linking as a link scheme (discount/penalty) — ratio must be controlled (system warning threshold: 30%). Practice: only reciprocate with curated topical sites / complementary brands, keep it natural.

periodic.zh: 周期查询工作流：每次分析自动并入「外链池」（按域名去重，累计发现次数、首见/末见时间、最佳校验状态）。重复运行会不断扩充地址列表。导入你的真实已有外链（GSC / Ahrefs / 自建 Common Crawl 导出，每行一个域名）后，系统标记「已拥有」，其余即「空缺」待拓展。
periodic.en: Periodic workflow: every analysis auto-merges into the 'backlink pool' (dedup by domain, accumulates discovery count, first/last seen, best validation status). Repeated runs keep expanding the address list. Import your real existing backlinks (GSC / Ahrefs / self-hosted Common Crawl export, one domain per line) to mark them 'acquired'; the rest are the 'gap' to pursue.

industry_media.zh: 行业媒体/测评站。价值权重：最高（相关+权威双高）。可获取：难(12/30)。说明：如 BabyGearLab 同类测评站，正文/评测内链权重高、相关性强，是优先拓展对象。
industry_media.en: Industry media / review. Value weight: highest (high relevance + authority). Obtainability: hard (12/30). E.g. BabyGearLab-class review sites; in-content links carry high weight and relevance.

guest.zh: 客座博客(Guest Post)。价值权重：高。可获取：中(22/30)。说明：家庭户外/育儿/亲子出行类博客，链接落正文或作者 bio；可控、可规模化，重在内容质量与相关性。
guest.en: Guest post. Value weight: high. Obtainability: medium (22/30). Parenting/outdoor blogs; links in body or author bio; controllable and scalable.

resource.zh: 资源页/链接列表。价值权重：高（性价比好）。可获取：易(26/30)。说明："Best balance bike resources" 类 curated 页面天然收录外链，是高效获取来源。
resource.en: Resource / link list. Value weight: high (good ROI). Obtainability: easy (26/30). Curated 'best resources' pages naturally list outbound links.

directory.zh: 目录/导航站。价值权重：单链接偏低（多为低质/群发）。可获取：最易(28/30)。互链说明：目录天生收录链接，"你链我我链你"是其原生玩法；但 Google 把「以操纵 PageRank 为目的的互链」列为 link scheme，会降权/判违规。仅做有编辑标准的垂直目录（如儿童安全协会/骑行协会名录）互链，比例要自然。
directory.en: Directory. Value weight: low per-link (often low-quality/mass-submitted). Obtainability: easiest (28/30). Reciprocal note: directories natively list links, but manipulative reciprocal linking is a link scheme. Only curated topical directories; keep ratio natural.
directory.reciprocal_note: directory 与 reciprocal 已分开：本类型为「单向被收录」，不含互链关系；互链请归到独立的 reciprocal 类型。

community.zh: 社区/论坛/问答。价值权重：多 nofollow，重引流/品牌。可获取：中(20/30)。说明：Reddit / Quora / 育儿论坛，带来流量与品牌信号，nofollow 居多。
community.en: Community / forum / Q&A. Value weight: mostly nofollow, traffic/brand value. Obtainability: medium (20/30). Reddit/Quora/parenting forums drive traffic and brand signals.

social.zh: 社媒资料页。价值权重：nofollow，重品牌信号。可获取：易(16/30)。说明：Pinterest（儿童品类重镇）、Instagram、YouTube 简介外链。
social.en: Social profile. Value weight: nofollow, brand signal. Obtainability: easy (16/30). Pinterest (strong for kids gear), Instagram, YouTube bio links.

partner.zh: 互补品牌/合作站。价值权重：中高（非竞品盟友）。可获取：中(18/30)。说明：儿童头盔/护具/童装/亲子旅行品牌，互换或协同内容。
partner.en: Partner / complementary brand. Value weight: medium-high (non-competitor ally). Obtainability: medium (18/30). Kids-helmet/apparel/travel brands; swap or co-create content.

authority.zh: 安全/权威机构(.gov/.org)。价值权重：信任权重最高。可获取：最难(8/30)。说明：儿童安全组织、骑行协会、gov 安全指南，信任度极高但极难获取，优先级权重最高。
authority.en: Safety / authority (.gov/.org). Value weight: highest trust. Obtainability: hardest (8/30). Child-safety orgs, cycling associations, gov safety guides; very high trust, very hard to earn.

digital_pr.zh: 数字PR/新闻源。价值权重：被引用则极高。可获取：难(10/30)。说明：通过 HARO / 记者求助提供专家观点，获取媒体 / .edu 外链。
digital_pr.en: Digital PR / news. Value weight: extremely high if cited. Obtainability: hard (10/30). Use HARO / journalist queries to provide expert quotes for media / .edu links.

reciprocal.zh: 互链(双向交换)。价值权重：单条最低（铺量兜底，非主力权重来源）。可获取：最易(29/30)。说明：与对方互相挂链；与 directory 已分开统计。必须控比例（超 30% 触发告警），仅与有编辑标准的垂直站点/互补品牌互链，避免 link scheme 降权。
reciprocal.en: Reciprocal link (mutual exchange). Value weight: lowest per-link (volume backstop, not primary authority). Obtainability: easiest (29/30). You and the partner link to each other; tracked separately from directory. Ratio must be controlled (warn above 30%); only with curated topical sites / complementary brands to avoid link-scheme discount.
reciprocal.reciprocal_note: 独立类型，与 directory 分开；系统对互链占比做告警（阈值 30%）。
